description_en: Queries information about an office network, including its status, cloud computer quantity, virtual private cloud (VPC) type, and more
description_zh: 查询办公网络（原工作区）的概览信息，包括状态、云电脑数量、VPC网络类型等
kebab_example: aliyun ecd list-office-site-overview --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --force-refresh false --max-results 10 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-3633530000 --query-range 1 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOfficeSiteOverview

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to refresh the cache
parameters.name: force_refresh

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，每页最大行数。    

最大值：100。    
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that determines the start point of the next query. If this is your first query or no next query is to be sent, skip this parameter. If a next query is to be sent, set the parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call
parameters.help_zh: 下一次查询的令牌（Token）。第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The office network IDs. You can specify IDs of 1 to 100 office networks
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en:
The query scope. Cloud computers in a cloud computer pool are pooled cloud computers.

Default values:

1 (default): queries non-pooled cloud computers in the office network.

2: queries pooled cloud computers in the office network.

3: queries all cloud computers in the office network
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围。池化云电脑是指云电脑池（原桌面组）中的云电脑
parameters.name: query_range
